metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve Your Scoliosis Back Pain in 30 SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over stretches and exercises that may help relieve your scoliosis back pain in 30 seconds. All these scoliosis stretches and exercises are simple, straight-forward and can be done AT HOME!

These stretches and exercises are SAFE, natural movements that will help deal with pain caused from a spine curvature in your back, known as scoliosis. You may find they give back pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS! 

The key to getting QUICK scoliosis pain relief is to stretch the tight muscles around the curve in the back, while also strengthening weak muscles. 

All of these exercises have this goal in mind, which makes them extremely EFFECTIVE towards helping to get rid of tight, achy muscles and joints caused by a scoliosis. 

So watch now and relieve your scoliosis back pain!
